title: Zoox will start charging for robotaxi rides in Las Vegas on August 10
excerpt: Amazon's Zoox sets August 10 for its first paid robotaxi service in Las Vegas. Fares will match "comfort" tier ride-hail pricing. Nearly 1 million free rides completed so far.
content_html:
TL;DR

Zoox launches paid robotaxi rides in Las Vegas on August 10 after completing nearly 1 million free rides. Pricing matches “comfort” tier ride-hailing. State approvals needed to expand.

Amazon’s Zoox will begin charging for robotaxi rides in Las Vegas on August 10, the company confirmed on Wednesday. Fares will be calculated from a base price plus distance and time, with destination fees for trips to and from the airport. Zoox said pricing will be competitive with “comfort” tier ride-hailing services, a step above the cheapest options from Uber and Lyft.

This follows the NHTSA exemption granted in July that made Zoox the first company allowed to charge for rides in a purpose-built robotaxi with no steering wheel or pedals. Since launching free rides last year, Zoox has transported nearly one million passengers across Las Vegas, San Francisco, Austin, and Miami.

“However hard it was to build the technology up to get up to this point, there’s a new hard that’s coming, which is paid operations,” CEO Aicha Evans said. “It’s different when it’s free vs. when the customer is going to pay.” Zoox will need state and local approvals to expand paid service beyond Las Vegas. Not all states are receptive: New York abandoned a robotaxi proposal in February, and New York City let a Waymo permit expire in March.

content_html_zh:
TL;DR

Zoox 在完成近 100 万次免费乘车后，于 8 月 10 日在拉斯维加斯推出付费机器人出租车服务。 定价与“舒适”级别的叫车服务相匹配。 需要扩大国家审批范围。

亚马逊周三证实，Zoox 将于 8 月 10 日开始在拉斯维加斯开始对机器人出租车收费。 票价将根据基本价格加上距离和时间以及往返机场的目的地费用计算。 Zoox 表示，其定价将与“舒适”级打车服务相比具有竞争力，比 Uber 和 Lyft 最便宜的服务高出一步。

此前，NHTSA 于 7 月份获得了豁免，Zoox 成为第一家获准对不带方向盘或踏板的专用机器人出租车进行收费的公司。 自去年推出免费乘车服务以来，Zoox 已在拉斯维加斯、旧金山、奥斯汀和迈阿密运送了近百万乘客。

首席执行官艾查·埃文斯 (Aicha Evans) 表示：“无论建立目前的技术有多困难，新的困难即将到来，那就是付费运营。” “免费时与客户付费时是不同的。” Zoox 需要获得州和地方的批准才能将付费服务扩展到拉斯维加斯以外的地区。 并非所有州都愿意接受：纽约在 2 月份放弃了机器人出租车提案，纽约市让 Waymo 许可证在 3 月份到期。
